nodes.label: 停滞检测 (stall detection 兜底/保护机制)
nodes.rationale: 停滞检测是兜底/保护机制, 本意是防止死等 (卡在投放等待中), 当 pixel_error 持续稳定在阈值以下足够时长时强制投放。本次改参 stall_threshold=45, stable_band=10, duration=5 后仍不触发, 因为两个退出条件反复打断: (1) pixel_error 单帧一跳就超过 45 直接退出停滞状态 (日志 T+2095: 42.2→59.4→50.3→48.5→37.4→22.6; T+2155: 47.1→75.6→80.7→94.0→102.7→98.2→80.2→71.5→50.4→43.1); (2) 两帧都在 45 以下时, 帧间跳变 10-20px 会重置停滞计时器。5 秒连续低于 45px 的稳定帧从未积累到; 且误差逼近 30px 时 is_precise() 就通过 stable_count 积累并进入 final_brake, 停滞检测根本来不及攒够 5 秒。
nodes.norm_label: 停滞检测 (stall detection 兜底/保护机制)

nodes.label: stall_threshold 参数 (=45px)
nodes.rationale: 停滞检测退出条件之一: pixel_error 一旦超过 stall_threshold 立即退出停滞状态。实际序列经常单帧跳超 45, 导致停滞状态被反复打断、无法累计时长。

nodes.label: stable_band 参数 (=10px)
nodes.rationale: 停滞检测要求帧间波动小于 stable_band (10px) 才算稳定; 实际帧间跳变达 10-20px, 停滞计时器被不断重置。

nodes.label: duration 参数 (=5秒)
nodes.rationale: 停滞检测要求的连续稳定时长; 日志中从未积累到 5 秒连续低于 45px 且帧间波动 <10px。

nodes.label: pixel_error (视觉对齐误差度量)
nodes.rationale: 停滞检测、is_precise()、刹车后漂移判定都基于 pixel_error 序列。日志显示其振荡剧烈 (T+2095 与 T+2155 两段序列反复越过 45px), 且刹车后 2-3 秒持续超出 raw_tol(35px), 使 '误差已经很小但不收敛' 与 '误差剧烈振荡' 成为两个不同的故障模式。

nodes.label: final_brake 状态 (L148-150)
nodes.rationale: 误差逼近 30px 时 is_precise() 通过 stable_count 积累并最终进入 final_brake; 其中 brake_step() 不再更新 pixel_error 对应的速度脉冲 (L148-150), 形成'误差清零'的循环空转, 停滞检测根本来不及攒够 5 秒。

nodes.label: is_precise() 精确定位判定
nodes.rationale: 投放许可条件之一: 需要连续 stable_frames(5) 帧通过。每次误差逼近 30px 时 is_precise() 就通过 stable_count 积累, 把流程推入 final_brake, 反而绕开了停滞检测的兜底。

nodes.label: brake_step() 刹车步进函数
nodes.rationale: final_brake 中调用的刹车步进 (L148-150); 进入后不再更新 pixel_error 对应的速度脉冲, 导致误差清零循环空转。

nodes.label: 停滞检测参数分析笔记 (Stall Detection Parameter Analysis Notes)
nodes.description: 截图: 关于投放精校停滞检测参数调优的分析笔记(中文)。内容包含: 1) 参数建议表 (stall_threshold 25->45->55, stall_stable_band 10->18, stall_duration 5->3.5, 理由: tolerance=35 需 20px 风噪余量, 风大帧间跳动常达 15px; 5s 太长 3.5s 够判断真停滞); 2) 45/10/5 未触发原因: 帧序列 43/50/38/52/29/35/47px 反复穿越 45px 阈值, threshold 时长与 stable_band 两把锁被风吹反复重置, 从未攒够时长; 3) 关键认知: 停滞检测是兜底, 真正该通的路径是 is_precise() -> final_brake -> speed 0.15 -> release -> ready -> 投放; 4) 风险: stall_threshold 设太低(靠近 tolerance)导致投放精度变差, 55 给 tolerance(35) 留 20px 缓冲区并强制放行。
nodes.norm_label: 停滞检测参数分析笔记 (stall detection parameter analysis notes)

nodes.label: 停滞检测参数调优 (Stall Detection Parameter Tuning)
nodes.rationale: tolerance 已改为 35, 风大时 pixel_error 抖动剧烈, 需 20px 风噪余量 (风大帧间跳动常达 15px), 故 stall_threshold 建议 55 而非 45; stall_stable_band 10 太容易被帧间跳动打破, 建议 18; stall_duration 5s 太长, 3.5s 足够判断真停滞。stall_threshold 若设得太低(靠近 tolerance)会导致投放精度变差; 55 给 tolerance(35) 留了 20px 缓冲区, 支持强制放行。

nodes.label: 45/10/5 停滞检测未触发原因分析 (Why 45/10/5 Stall Detection Did Not Trigger)
nodes.rationale: 看日志实际序列: 帧1 43px(<45), 帧2 50px(>45 退出停滞), 帧3 38px(<45), 帧4 52px(>45 退出), 帧5 29px(<45), 帧6 35px 波动, 帧7 47px(>45 退出)。pixel_error 在 45px 阈值两侧反复穿越: threshold 时长太容易被风一吹就越界, stable_band=10 也太容易被帧间跳动打破, 两把锁(停滞计时 + 稳定带宽)反复重置, 从来没攒够判定秒数。
nodes.norm_label: 45/10/5 停滞检测未触发原因分析 (why 45/10/5 stall detection did not trigger)

nodes.label: 停滞检测是兜底 (Stall Detection Is a Fallback)
nodes.rationale: 关键认知: 停滞检测是兜底, 真正该通的路径是 is_precise() -> final_brake -> speed 0.15 -> release -> ready -> 投放。正常路径通了之后停滞检测大概率不再需要, 只在极端情况下才介入(如收敛到 30PX 持续 5 帧)。

nodes.label: Bucket World-Projection Horizontal Filter Defect
nodes.rationale: The bucket world-projection horizontal distance filter max(pose[2]*1.5, 3.0) anchors to the arbitrary PX4 vertical origin. With negative World z the range is pinned at 3 m, rejecting a valid 3.394 m projection; reproduced with the jetson original function. Proven defect, but not provably the sole cause of both flights stalling in search.

nodes.label: Quick Bucket Search Height 5.6→4.5 m
nodes.rationale: User-confirmed change, real and SITL synchronized: bucket-mouth-to-camera distance drops 5.235→4.135 m, pixel size grows ~27%, so a scan must be added to keep single-frame coverage.

nodes.label: Algorithmic Failures Dominate Wind
nodes.rationale: Same precision-align algorithm within one minute: stable 24-37 px during servo-descent, then 40 s limit cycle after the hover re-check state switch. A 20 s non-converging ±0.24 m/s saturated oscillation is the signature of target-association switching + low gain + EMA lag self-oscillation; the clean 9 s re-convergence after reset rules out wind as primary cause.

nodes.label: RTK Quality Gate (PositionQualityGate)
nodes.rationale: Optional project-level gate: allow INIT→ARM only when RTK Fixed (fix_type=6), RTCM used by the Rover, data not stale and EKF XY valid. Implemented as one deep module in px4_control exposing observe_gps/observe_local_position/is_ready/reason, so the FSM reads only bridge.position_ready and RTK checks never scatter across states.

nodes.label: EKF2_GPS_CTRL=5 Height-Bit-Off Rationale
nodes.rationale: Keep EKF2_GPS_CTRL at 5 (lat+vel fusion, height bit off): the height reference was moved to the rangefinder via EKF2_HGT_REF=2, and restoring 7 makes GPS fight the rangefinder for the height reference. Do not add bit 3 (dual-antenna heading) without verified dual-antenna hardware.

nodes.label: Bucket Blue Pre-Descent Stage
nodes.rationale: The blue disc is a navigation cue only, never a bucket-mouth or release permission. Three distinct camera frames within 1 s start a visual servo down to 3.0 m while cylinder candidates keep accumulating; world projection is coarse reference and never vetoes the pre-descent.

nodes.label: Cylinder-Only Low-Altitude Visual Alignment
nodes.rationale: After selection, the cylinder current image is the sole control target for descent and terminal horizontal servo. The blue disc serves only high-altitude pre-descent and observation/logging, never a low-altitude tracking substitute, release permission or timeout-release precondition — losing the cylinder stops horizontal micro-correction instead of switching servo targets.

nodes.label: World Projection as Coarse Reference Only
nodes.rationale: High-altitude bucket-mouth world coordinates come from image projection whose error must not veto search, selection, descent start or final centering. Valid world coordinates only give a rough approach direction; the current camera image of the cylinder alone decides tracking and descent.
nodes.norm_label: world projection as coarse reference only

nodes.label: Ground-Error Release Budget Arithmetic
nodes.rationale: Ø15 cm acceptance leaves only 1.6-2.6 cm after release drift and centering residual, so the system bias must be pinned below 1 cm; at 1.2 m drop height 1 px = 3 mm and a 10 px cx error is 3 cm. Hence the 0.03 m ground-error gate, the 1.2 m two-stage descent and camera calibration are all phase-1 necessities, not optimizations.

nodes.label: Hold Actual Yaw During Takeoff, Turn After 5 m
nodes.rationale: px4_bridge dyaw*0.3 is a discrete low-pass, not a physical yaw-rate limit: at 20 Hz a 0°→30° target can jump ~9° in the first cycle, causing roll, power redistribution and altitude fluctuation on a real aircraft. So pre-arm, arm, Offboard switch and climb keep the actual current yaw; only after the 5 m TAKEOFF check passes does the mission yaw switch to layout_heading_deg.

nodes.label: Small-Bucket 4.5 cm Budget Arithmetic
nodes.rationale: The front bottle sits ~0.04 m forward of the body, leaving only ~0.005 m static margin for a 7.5 cm-radius bucket mouth when the body/camera center points at the bucket center. The release gate must therefore use the predicted front-bottle impact point (release-point offsets, yaw rotation, measured velocities and fall time), never the image center or a single pixel threshold.

nodes.label: Gazebo Transport Native Python Subscription
nodes.rationale: The per-frame gz topic --num 1 --json-output bridge only published ~3 FPS against a ~30 FPS Gazebo camera, so the five-distinct-frames-per-second bucket gate was unreachable in SITL. Native Gazebo Transport subscription reached ~15 FPS and fixed the bottleneck at the source.
